physicalNotes: Radius 0.22521451 Jupiter radii from Polanski et al. 2024 (2024ApJS..272...32P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract): 16,101 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.03366596 Jupiter masses (Polanski et al. 2024, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2024ApJS..272...32P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.
